citation: Loebig M, et al. Evidence for a relationship between VEGF and BMI independent of insulin sensitivity by glucose clamp procedure in a homogenous group of healthy young men. PLoS ONE 2010;5:e12610.
protocol: Hyperinsulinaemic-euglycaemic clamp after a baseline period: insulin bolus 5 mU/kg/min for 2 min then 1.5 mU/kg/min for 100 min; 20% dextrose varied to hold plasma glucose at 5.5 mmol/L.
population: 45 men aged 18-30 y in three groups of 15: normal weight (BMI 20-25), low weight (BMI<20), obese (BMI>30); healthy, non-diabetic.

reports.marker: glucose infusion rate (ml/h) and M value (mg/kg/min)

note: Small, homogeneous young male group with clamp-state glucose, insulin, C-peptide and M printed per BMI group. Values are single clamp-period means, not a time course; GIR is in ml/h and M in mg/kg/min.
